reviews.test_assessment: The old source compares endpoint TPOT with adjacent-gap summation, nearest-rank results with empirical-CDF inequalities, cohort classification with event replay, clocks with feasible-offset enumeration, audio recurrence with discrete playback, and PCM conversion with packed-byte lengths. Some probes deliberately alter reports and are correctly labeled sensitivity checks. The new source adds exact hand census/rates, resource-position enumeration, finite unresolved-label assignments and executed erroneous reducer branches. Independent methods support the stated finite examples; shared input fingerprints establish input identity rather than oracle independence. The supplied current preflight reports PASS and matching cross-script summaries, without establishing service or hardware behavior.

reviews.test_assessment: The old source checks cold endpoints against independently supplied stage durations, run variance against a pairwise identity and absolute examples, and the rare-tail counterexample by exact binomial masses and count-based moments. Its supplied t critical value checks arithmetic rather than distributional validity. The new source checks signed factorial contrasts, missing/duplicate cells, literal-copy standardization, mixture CDFs and queue counterexamples. A separate event replay verifies the service example against endpoint reduction, including quality failure and absorbing timeout. Several negative controls are direct wrong calculations or decision substitutions rather than complete faulty experimental systems; they support their narrow stated purpose. The supplied preflight reports PASS, without causal identification or real service validation.
